title: Lazy singleton value with volatile double-checked locking
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag double-checked locking itself as the classic broken pattern. This is the corrected form: the field is volatile, which is exactly what makes the idiom safe under the Java memory model (the volatile write on publication happens-before any later volatile read, so no partially constructed object can be seen); the first check is unsynchronised for the fast path; the local variable avoids a second volatile read on return; and a null supplier result is rejected so 'not yet initialised' stays unambiguous instead of being cached as a permanent null.
